summary: Backend-only test of the Paid-to-College auto-debit fix. 4/4 pytest cases passed (historical backfill x2, E2E create/patch/idempotency/amount-change/remove/cascade-delete, College-Acc no-tx). All throwaway data cleaned up (TEST_P2C students deleted, no linked transactions left, account balances restored).

minor.issue: Paid-to-College expense txs are created with category_id=null: no expense category named 'Paid to College' exists for the owner (admin@kmfoundation.online). All 4 P2C expenses (130000, 100000, 25000, 5000) are uncategorized, so they show as uncategorized on Transactions and in category reports. Fix: seed or auto-create the category (upsert) inside _auto_log_payment_transaction.

The review note says the data is visible in a 'shared super-admin data context', but it isn't. Transactions and accounts are filtered strictly by user_id, so muneer@kmfoundation.co gets 0 transactions and 0 accounts. The historical debits are only visible when logged in as the legacy admin admin@kmfoundation.online. Confirm this is intended.

action_items: Create or upsert an expense category 'Paid to College' and set category_id on the auto debits (also backfill the 4 existing null-category rows).
Confirm whether the primary super admin (muneer) should see the legacy admin's transactions and accounts. Right now they are user-scoped and invisible to him.
critical_code_review_comments: _auto_log_payment_transaction: a payment received as type 'cash' with no account_id, or with fee_type 'sc_adjusted', falls back to the default account, so a paid_to_college adjustment on it also debits that default account. This is probably fine but it is implicit; confirm it is the intended behaviour.
students.py is far over 700 lines (update_payment is around line 1680). Consider splitting the payments and transaction-sync logic into its own module.
